why: The optional street map in the estate map. MapLibre GL JS (vendored, BSD-3-Clause) draws OpenFreeMap's Positron style. Without these exceptions the app still works: the street map button is disabled with the reason, and the built-in outline map shows the same figures.

vendor/maplibre/maplibre-gl-csp.js.note: MapLibre starts its tile worker from vendor/maplibre/maplibre-gl-csp-worker.js (same origin, set by map-street.js). The javascript: string is an internal link-sanitising check, not a navigation.

allow: fetch to another origin (connect-src 'self'; use a connector)
vendor/maplibre/maplibre-gl-csp-worker.j.note: The worker fetches tiles, glyphs and sprites from tiles.openfreemap.org only, as listed in connect-src.
